title: Reno — Restore Train Dialogue
description: Temporarily restore Reno's ordinary conversation so the repaired model train can be handed over through the game. The completed kibble deal and papers are preserved.
evidence: Confirmed in a local game session on release 1.1 / changeset 40781. Not a claim of compatibility with other story branches.
risk: Temporarily clears the historical request-for-kibble flag. It also affects conditional lines in other conversations. Hand over the train, create a NEW manual save, then use Reno — Restore Historical Flag on that new save. Do not replay the kibble deal.

title: Reno — Restore Historical Flag
description: Use on a NEW save made after Reno accepted the train in the game. Restore the original request-for-kibble flag while preserving the game's train handover, reward and inventory changes.
evidence: Confirmed after an actual in-game train handover on release 1.1 / changeset 40781.
risk: Reno may return to Goodbye-only conversation. This restores the original dialogue routing after the train has already been handed over. Do not use an old pre-handover save as the source.
